Nested retry filters do not multiply - the innermost policy that handles the exception decides, in both orders and through a dispatch boundary. Ignore<T> disables retry for that exception and for an exception carrying it as inner exception. Exponential intervals are computed once. A ridiculous retry count does not stack overflow. The policy context is disposed exactly once.
boundaries: Interval(4, 2ms) -> 5 attempts; Interval(20000, 0) -> 20001 attempts; Exponential(10, ...) -> 11 attempts; Immediate(1) success on second attempt.
